about: At Gaza and in Egypt the escort marvel that a thirteen-day road was crossed in one day without weariness; at the Takkaze they set down the carts, dismiss the crowd and tell their king, who has promised silence, that the Ark is with them by God's will, not theirs. Azarias bids Elmeyanos adorn and clothe the Ark, and the king, at the thought of seeing Zion, dances like David before it.

sentences.i: And at the place where they stayed was Gaza, the city of the king's mother, which King Solomon gave to the queen of Ethiopia when she came to him.
sentences.n: ወበኀበ ወ- 'and' + በ- 'at' + ኀበ 'place where'; ኀደሩሰ 'they dwelt' (ኀደረ) with the emphatic particle -ሰ. ሀገረ እሙ ለንጉሥ 'city-of his-mother of-the-king': እሙ is እም 'mother' + -ሁ 'his' (contracted), doubled by ለንጉሥ (the owner named after the suffixed noun), so 'the city of the king's mother'; she is Queen Makeda and 'the king' is her son Menelik. ዘወሀባ 'which he gave her' (ዘ- + ወሀበ + -ኣ 'her', written -ባ). ሶበ 'when'. The word order puts ንጉሥ ሰሎሞን after ትመጽእ ኀቤሁ 'she came to him', so 'to him' = Solomon. ኢትዮጽያ is Bezold's spelling here (elsewhere ኢትዮጵያ). ጋዛ Gaza (as printed).

sentences.l: And-when they-saw sons-of mighty-ones-of Israel that in-one day they-arrived journey-of 13 day, and-not they-tired and-not they-hungered and-not they-thirsted neither man nor beast, and-all-of-them as-when at-once (?) they-were-full and-drank, they-knew and-they-believed those sons-of might that from-with God was this
sentences.i: When the sons of the mighty ones of Israel saw that they had covered in one day a journey of thirteen days, and that they were not tired, hungry or thirsty, neither man nor beast, but all of them were as if they had just eaten their fill and drunk, those sons of strength knew and believed that this had come from God.
sentences.n: A long unit built from one ሶበ 'when' clause (ርእዩ here is the 3mp perfect 'they saw') and a ከመ 'that' clause. ደቂቀ ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'sons-of mighty-ones-of Israel' (construct chain; ኀያላን plural of ኀያል 'mighty'). ምሕዋረ is the construct (or accusative) of ምሕዋር 'way, journey', followed by ፲ወ፫ ዕለት, the numeral ፲ወ፫ 'thirteen' (spoken ዐሠርቱ ወሠለስቱ, 'ten and three'). The three negatives ወኢደክሙ ወኢርኅቡ ወኢጸምኡ ('and-not they-tired / hungered / thirsted'; perfects of ደከመ, ርኅበ, ጸምአ) are followed by ኢሰብእ ወኢእንስሳ 'neither man nor beast'. ከመ ዘሶቤ 'as when at once' (?): ከመ before ዘ- is 'as when' (published parts); ሶቤ 'at once, then'; the sense is 'as though they had just eaten' (?). ጸግቡ 'were sated' (ጸገበ). አእመሩ 'they knew' (አእመረ) and አምኑ 'they believed' (perfect). ደቂቀ ኀይል 'sons-of strength / might' is the term for the young men of Israel who escort the Ark. እምኀበ እግዚኣብሔር 'from with God'. The pattern 'sign of divine power on the journey' recurs in these chapters.

sentences.i: They said to their king, 'Let us bring the carts down, for we have reached the waters of Ethiopia: this is the Takkaze, which flows down from Ethiopia and waters the river of Egypt.'
sentences.n: ወይቤልዎ 'and they said to him' (3mp perfect ይቤሉ of ብህለ + -ልዎ 'to him', the plural of ይቤሎ); the king is Menelik (ለንጉሦሙ 'to their king'). ናውርድ 'let us bring down' (causative አውረደ of ወረደ 'descend'; the ን- jussive, 'let us'). ሰረገላተ 'chariots, carts' is the broken plural. እስመ 'for'. በጻሕነ 'we have arrived' (1pl of በጽሐ). ተከዚ is the Takkaze (Tekezé), the Ethiopian river that runs to the Nile; ዛቲ ይእቲ 'this (is) she'. ትሰቂ 'it gives to drink / waters' (ሰቀየ, related to ሰትየ 'drink'; not simply its causative, stem uncertain (?)), ፈለገ ግብጽ 'river-of Egypt', the Nile. The speakers present the Takkaze as the first water of Ethiopia on the road home.

sentences.i: The sons of strength went off together and sent away all the people. And they said to their king, 'May we tell you something, if you are able to bear it (?)?'
sentences.n: ወሖሩ 'and they went' (ሖረ). ኅቡረ 'together' (accusative adverb). ሰደዱ 'they sent away, dismissed' (ሰደደ). ኵሎ አሕዛበ 'all peoples' (ኵሎ + accusative plural of ሕዝብ). ንንግርከኑ 'may we tell you?' The secret is the Ark's presence; the king promises silence in the next unit.

sentences.i: He said to them, 'Yes, I can. And if you tell me, until the day of my death I will not bring it out, nor give any answer (?).'
sentences.n: ወይቤሎሙ 'and he said to them'. እወ 'yes'. እክል 'I am able'. ወለእመ ትቤሉኒ 'and if you tell me' (ትቤሉ, 2mp perfect of ብህለ, 'you have said to' + -ኒ 'me'; a perfect after ለእመ). እስከ ዕለተ ሞትየ 'until day-of my-death' (construct). ኢያወፅእ ወኢያወሥእ 'he does not bring out / does not answer' (?): a paired negation (ያወፅእ causative of ወጽአ 'go out'; ያወሥእ is አውሥአ 'answer', as in ch. 23 and 33–35 of the published parts, not a verb 'enter', which would be አብአ); the 3ms stands for 'I' or 'one'. The sense is a vow not to divulge it nor reply (?). Dillmann is unavailable, hence the hedge.

sentences.l: And-they-said-to-him: she-descended sun from-heaven and-she-was-given at-Sinai to-Israel and-she-became salvation for-kin-of Adam from Moses until seed-of Jesse, and-behold with-you by-will-of God
sentences.i: They said to him: 'The sun came down from heaven and was given on Sinai to Israel, and she became salvation for the race of Adam, from Moses until the seed of Jesse; and behold, she is with you, by the will of God.
sentences.n: ፀሐይ 'sun' is feminine here (ወረደት, ተውህበት, ኮነት all with feminine -ት): the 'sun' is Zion, the Ark (ታቦት), in the book's Zion/Ark theology; her descent from heaven and gift at Sinai echo the giving of the Law (Exodus 19). ዘመደ አዳም 'kin-of Adam' (construct). እምነ ሙሴ እስከ ዘርአ እሴይ 'from Moses to the seed of Jesse', i.e. to David and his descendants (Jesse was David's father; Solomon is of that seed). ነዋ 'behold' (as in the published parts; 'she' is understood from the feminine subject; compare ነያ 'behold her' in unit 13). ኀቤከ 'with you', በፈቃደ 'by the will-of' (construct). The speech continues through unit 18.

sentences.i: We wished, and God accomplished; we prepared (?), and God made it good; we conferred, and God acted; we reflected, and God took counsel; we said, and God was pleased; we looked on, and God set it right; we reflected, and God made it firm.
sentences.n: A deliberate string of paired clauses: ንሕነ 'we' + a 1pl perfect (-ነ), then ወእግዚኣብሔር 'and God' + a 3sg perfect. Pairs: ፈቀድነ / ፈጸመ 'wished / completed'; ተሰናአውነ / አሠነየ 'made ourselves ready (?) / made good' (አሠነየ causative of ሠነየ 'be fair'); ተናገርነ / ገብረ 'spoke / did'; ኀለይነ / መከረ 'thought / counselled' (ኀለየ, መከረ); ንቤ / ሠምረ 'we said (1cp perfect of ብህለ: ይቤ, ትቤ, ንቤ) / was pleased'; አንጸርነ / አርትዐ 'we looked / made straight' (አርትዐ, causative of ርትዐ 'be upright'); ኀለይነ / አጽደቀ 'we thought / confirmed'. The same human/divine contrast is the point: human intention, divine accomplishment. Some readings are uncertain (?), especially ተሰናአውነ.

sentences.i: And now God has chosen you and been pleased with your land, so that you may be a servant of holy, heavenly Zion, the Ark of the law of God; and that she may be a guide to you for ever, to you and to your descendants after you, if you keep his command and do the will of God, your God.
sentences.n: ወይእዜኒ 'and now' (-ኒ emphatic). ኪያከ ኀረየ 'you he chose' (ኪያ- + -ከ puts the object first for emphasis; ኀረየ 'choose'). ከመ ትኩን 'that you be' (subjunctive), ላእከ 'minister, servant' in the accusative (?) with ለጽዮን 'to/of Zion' (the Ark, called ጽዮን here, with 'holy' and 'heavenly'). ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'Ark-of his-law of-God' (construct; ሕጉ 'his law' is doubled by ለእግዚኣብሔር, the owner named after the suffixed noun). ትኩንከ መርሐ 'may she be to-you a guide' (jussive, still under ከመ; መርሐ accusative). ዘርእከ 'your seed' (ዘርእ + -ከ). ለእመ 'if' + ዐቀብከ 'you keep' (ዐቀበ), ትእዛዞ 'his commandment' (-ኦ 'his', written -ዞ; doubled by ለእግዚኣብሔር after ፈቃዶ), ወገበርከ 'and you do'. sentences.i: For you could not send her back if you wished, and your father could not take her if he wished; for she herself goes where she pleases, and she does not rise from her seat unless she herself pleases.
sentences.n: አግብኦታ and ነሢኦታ are verbal nouns with the object suffix: 'bringing-her-back', 'taking-her' (አግብአ causative of ገብአ 'return'; ነሥአ 'take'); the second has no 'cannot' of its own, so ኢትክል 'you cannot' covers both ('and your father' = Solomon). ለሊሃ 'herself'. ተሐውር 'she goes' (ሖረ). ኀበ ፈቀደት 'to where she wished' (feminine verb, the Ark). ወኢትትነሣእ እመንበራ 'and she does not rise from her seat' (ትትነሣእ 3fs of ተንሥአ 'arise', the verb of ተንሥአ 'rose' in unit 19; + እም- 'from' + መንበር 'seat, throne' + -ኣ 'her'; the Ark's own seat). The Ark moves by its own will: key to the book's theology.

sentences.i: And here she is, our Lady, our mother and our salvation, our fortress and our refuge (?), our glory and the harbour of our salvation, for us who lean (?) upon her.
sentences.n: Two source words are fused in print: ይእቲእግዝእትነ = ይእቲ 'she' + እግዝእትነ 'our lady' (እግዝእት + -ነ); እምነወመድኀኒትነ = እምነ 'our mother' (እም + -ነ) + ወ- 'and' + መድኀኒትነ 'our salvation' (መድኀኒት + -ነ). I split them so. ነያ 'behold her' (see unit 8). Each noun takes the 1pl possessive -ነ: ጸወንነ 'our fortress', ምስካይነ 'our refuge', ክብርነ 'our glory', መርሶ 'harbour-of' (construct). ለእለ ናሰምክ ባቲ 'for those who lean on her': ናሰምክ 'we lean, rely' (?): the ና- is the 1cp prefix ን- before an initial አ, so the stem may be the causative (አሰመከ) rather than the plain ሰመከ; the ሰመከ of ch. 29 is a different, obscure word, and 'lean on' is a guess from the context (?). ምስካይ 'refuge' (?) (sense from context, as ምስካይኒ in ch. 51–52), with በ- + -ኣ 'her'. This is the book's Marian-style language for Zion as Lady, applied to the Ark.

sentences.i: When Azarias had said this, King David was startled; he laid both his hands upon his heart and drew three breaths. And he said: 'Is it true, O Lord, that you have remembered us (?) in your mercy, us outcasts (?), whom you set apart (?) as a people, so that I should see your pure dwelling, which is in the heavens, holy heavenly Zion?
sentences.n: ወዘንተ 'and this' (object, with ዘ-). ንጉሥ ዳዊት: the book calls the young king David, his regnal name; here this is Menelik, as the context shows (the king whose men address him, whose father is Solomon, and whom unit 20 compares to 'David, father of his father'). ደንገፀ 'was startled, shaken' (ደንገፀ). ክልኤሆን 'both of them' (feminine plural). አስተንፈሰ 'he breathed' (causative stem). አማንኑ 'in truth?' (አማን 'truly' + -ኑ). እግዚኦ 'O Lord' (vocative). ትዜከረነ: a 2ms perfect would be ዘከርከነ, so the form is irregular; it may be a spelling of ተዘከረነ (tä-stem, cf. ተዘከረ 'remembered' in ch. 46–48), 'he remembered us' or 'remember us!' (?); 'you remembered us' is a guess from the sense (?); በሣህልከ 'in-mercy-your'. ግዱፋን 'outcasts, abandoned' (?) and እለ መነንከ ሕዝብ 'whom you ... a people' (?), both uncertain (መነነ is 'renounced' in ch. 13–16, so 'set apart' is a guess; ሕዝብ stands with no preposition, so 'from' is not in the text). ከመ እርአያ ለማኅደርከ 'that I see (her) your dwelling' (ማኅደር 'dwelling'; ለ- marks the object). ንጽሕት 'pure'. Zion 'in the heavens' is the heavenly archetype of the Ark, as in the Zion theology. Echoes Psalm 132 (the Lord's dwelling).

sentences.n: ምንተኑ 'what then?' (ምንት + -ኑ). ነዐስዮ 'we shall repay him' (ዐሰየ 'repay, requite'); compare Psalm 116:12 (115:3 in the Greek numbering): 'What shall I render to the Lord for all his benefits?' ኵሉ ዘገብረ ለነ 'all that he did for us'; ሠናያተ 'good things' (plural). sentences.l: He-tells one to-his-other, and-they-leap all-of-them like ጣዕዋ (?) ox, and-they-stretch their-hands and-they-marvel (?) and-they-spread their-hands into heaven and-they-bow with-their-faces into earth and-they-thank God in-their-hearts
sentences.i: One tells another, and they all leap like a ጣዕዋ (?) ox, and stretch out their hands, and wonder (?), and spread their hands toward heaven, and bow with their faces to the ground, and give thanks to God in their hearts.
sentences.n: ይነግሮ ፩ ለካልኡ 'he tells (it) one to-his-other' (፩ is the numeral 'one'; ካልእ 'other', ለ- 'to'). ወያንፈርዕፁ 'and they leap' (plural of the verb in unit 19). ጣዕዋ is unknown to me (?); ላህም 'ox, cow'. ይጠፍሑ 'they stretch / spread' (ጠፍሐ); ያነክሩ is uncertain (?): 'they marvel / act strangely (?)'; ይሰፍሑ 'they spread (their hands)'. ይሰግዱ 'they bow' (ሰገደ) በገጾሙ 'with their faces'. ያአኵትዎ 'they give thanks to him' (አአኰተ + -ኦ) ለእግዚኣብሔር, ለ- marks the object again. በአልባቢሆሙ 'in their hearts' (plural of ልብ, with -ሆሙ). The final ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ is the chapter-end mark and belongs to the last unit.

glossary.አርትዐ: አርትዐ — he set right, made straight (3ms perfect, causative of ርትዐ 'be upright')
glossary.አንጸርነ: አንጸረ — we looked on (1cp perfect, a-stem, n-ṣ-r)
glossary.አእመሩ: አእመረ — they knew (3mpl perfect, a-stem, ʿ-m-r)
glossary.አዛርያስ: አዛርያስ — Azariah (proper name; here son of Zadok, high priest)
glossary.አዳም: አዳም — Adam · (?) as predicate in ወኵሉ ርእየቱ አዳም, probably an adjective 'pleasing, comely' (from the sense; unconfirmed); 'Adam' as the first perfect man also possible · Adam, in ዘመደ አዳም 'the kin of Adam' (the human race; ch. 53)
glossary.አግብኦታ: አግብአ — returning her, sending her back (infinitive አግብኦት + -ኣ '3fs her', causative of ገብአ 'return')
glossary.አጽሐሰ: አጽሐሰ — he danced, stamped (?) (3ms perfect; lexical call from context) (?)
glossary.አጽደቀ: አጽደቀ — he confirmed, made firm (3ms perfect, causative of ጸደቀ)
glossary.ኢሰብእ: ሰብእ — no man, neither man (ኢ- 'not' + noun ሰብእ 'man')
glossary.ኢትዮጽያ: ኢትዮጵያ — Ethiopia (proper name; variant spelling ኢትዮጽያ, dependent on the construct ንግሥተ)
glossary.ኢያወፅእ: አውጽአ — he does not bring out (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, causative of ወጽአ 'go out', w-ṣ-ʾ; in the vow of silence 'I will not bring it out') (?)
glossary.ኢፈቀደት: ፈቀደ — she did not wish (ኢ- 'not' + 3fs perfect, f-ḳ-d)
glossary.እመንበራ: መንበር — from her seat (እም- 'from' + noun መንበር 'seat, throne' + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.እሙ: እም — his mother (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted እሙ) · 'its mother' of an animal (ጽጉበ ሐሊበ እሙ 'sated with its mother's milk'; ch. 53)
glossary.እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
glossary.እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"'
glossary.እምነወመድኀኒትነ: እም — our mother and our salvation (two words written as one: እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our' + ወ- 'and' + መድኀኒት 'salvation' + -ነ 'our')
glossary.እርአያ: ርእየ — that I may see her (1cs jussive, r-ʾ-y, + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53)
glossary.እስትንፋሰ: እስትንፋስ — breath (noun, accusative; ሠለስተ እስትንፋሰ 'three breaths')
glossary.እብል: ብህለ — shall I say (1cs imperfect, b-h-l)
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?)
glossary.እንዘወኢምንትኒበኀቤሁ: እንዘ — while … nothing at all with him (written as one word: እንዘ 'while' + ወ- 'and' + ኢምንትኒ 'nothing at all' + በኀቤሁ 'with him')
glossary.እክል: ክህለ — I can, I am able (1cs imperfect, k-h-l)
glossary.ከለለነ: ከለለ — he covered us, sheltered us (3ms perfect + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ኬንያሃ: ኬንያ — her craftsman, maker (noun, 'craftsman, maker' (?) as in ch. 13–16, + -ሃ '3fs her'; parallel to ወገባሪሃ) (?)
glossary.ክልኤሆን: ክልኤቱ — both of them (feminine; numeral 'two' + -ሆን '3fp', of the hands)
glossary.ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two')
glossary.ኮነት: ኮነ — become, be (3fs perfect; subject መንግሥተ)
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ወሀገርከ: ሀገር — and your land (ወ- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ወለእመ: እመ — and if (ወ- + ለእመ, conditional conjunction)
glossary.ወለዘርእከ: ዘርእ — and to your seed (ወ- + ለ- 'to' + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ወሖሩ: ሖረ — and they went (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ወመርሶ: መርሶ — and harbour, haven (ወ- + noun; construct 'harbour of')
glossary.ወምስካይነ: ምስካይ — and our refuge (ወ- + noun + -ነ '1cp our'; sense from context, as ምስካይኒ in ch. 51–52) (?)
glossary.ወምንተ: ምንት — and what? (ወ- 'and' + interrogative pronoun, accusative)
glossary.ወምንተኑ: ምንት — and what then? (ወ- + interrogative pronoun + -ኑ)
glossary.ወሰትዩ: ሰትየ — and they drank (ወ- + 3mpl perfect, s-t-y)
glossary.ወሰደዱ: ሰደደ — and they sent away, dismissed (ወ- + 3mpl perfect, s-d-d)
glossary.ወቀጸቦ: ቀጸበ — and he called aside, took aside (?) (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኦ '3ms him', written -ቦ; meaning from the sense) (?)
glossary.ወበኀበ: ኀበ — and before, with (ወ- + በ- + ኀበ) · and among (ወበኀበ አብዳንሰ 'and among fools') · and at the place where (ወበኀበ ኀደሩሰ 'and where they dwelt'; ch. 53)
glossary.ወተሀለለ: ተሀለለ — and he praised, sang praise (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወተሐሠየ: ተሐሠየ — and he rejoiced (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem; cf. ሐሤት 'joy')
glossary.ወተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — and he arose (ወ- + 3ms perfect, Gt)
glossary.ወተከሉ: ተከለ — and they planted, pitched (ወ- + 3mpl perfect, t-k-l; of tents)
glossary.ወተውህበት: ተውህበ — and she was given (ወ- + 3f sg perfect, passive of ወሀበ)
glossary.ወትሰቂ: ሰቀየ — and she gives drink, waters (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, s-q-y; stem uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወነዋ: ነዋ — and behold, here is (ወ- + interjection ነዋ)
glossary.ወነያ: ነያ — and behold her (ወ- + ነያ, demonstrative particle + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወንግነይ: ገነየ — and let us praise (ወ- + 1cp jussive, g-n-y 'bow, serve, praise')
glossary.ወአልብሳ: አልበሰ — and clothe her! (ወ- + 2ms imperative, causative of ለበሰ 'wear', l-b-s, + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወአምኑ: አምነ — and they believed (ወ- + 3mpl perfect, ʾ-m-n)
glossary.ወአስተንፈሰ: አስተንፈሰ — and he breathed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative-reflexive stem)
glossary.ወአቡከ: አብ — and your father (ወ- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ወአንበረ: አንበረ — and he placed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ነበረ)
glossary.ወአውረዱ: አውረደ — and they brought down (ወ- + 3mpl perfect, causative of ወረደ)
glossary.ወኢርኅቡ: ርኅበ — and they were not hungry (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mpl perfect, r-ḫ-b)
glossary.ወኢትትነሣእ: ተንሥአ — and she does not rise (ወ- + ኢ- + 3fs imperfect ትትነሣእ, tä-stem, n-s-ʾ; the Ark is the subject)
glossary.ወኢእንስሳ: እንስሳ — and no beast, nor beast (ወ- + ኢ- + collective noun እንስሳ 'beast, animal')
glossary.ወኢያወሥእ: አውሥአ — and he does not answer (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, causative, w-ś-ʾ; written ያወሥእ, as in ch. 23; the 'answer' sense suits the vow of silence) (?)
glossary.ወኢደክሙ: ደከመ — and they were not weary (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 3mpl perfect, d-k-m)
glossary.ወኢጸምኡ: ጸምአ — and they were not thirsty (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mpl perfect, ṣ-m-ʾ)
glossary.ወእምህየ: ህየ — and from there (ወ- + እም- 'from' + adverb)
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this')
glossary.ወኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — and all of them, and all (ወ- + ኵሉ + -ሙ '3mp')
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወያነክሩ: አነከረ — and they marvel (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, causative; takes accusative object)
glossary.ወያአኵትዎ: አአኰተ — and they give thanks to him (ወ- + 3mpl imperfect + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወይሰግዱ: ሰገደ — and they will bow down (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, s-g-d)
glossary.ወይሰፍሑ: ሰፍሐ — and they spread out (ወ- + 3mpl imperfect, s-f-ḥ)
glossary.ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይጠፍሑ: ጠፍሐ — and they stretch out (ወ- + 3mpl imperfect, ṭ-f-ḥ)
glossary.ወገበርከ: ገብረ — and you do (ወ- + 2ms perfect, g-b-r; 'if you keep … and do')
glossary.ወገባሪሃ: ገባሪ — and her maker (ወ- + agent noun + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ዐቀብከ: ዐቀበ — you have kept, guarded (2ms perfect, ʿ-q-b)
glossary.ዕለተ: ዕለት — day (noun, fem., construct state 'day-of') · also the accusative singular after a numeral (፯ ዕለተ 'seven days')
glossary.ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
glossary.ዘሶቤ: ሶቤ — at once, just then (ዘ- + ሶቤ 'at once, then'; ከመ ዘሶቤ 'as when at once', 'as if just then') (?)
glossary.ዘተገብረ: ተገብረ — which was done (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, passive of ገብረ)
glossary.ዘወሀባ: ወሀበ — which he gave her (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኣ 3fs object suffix) · which he gave it (feminine object, the city: ሀገር ዘወሀባ ሰሎሞን)
glossary.ዘገብረ: ገብረ — what he did (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, g-b-r)
glossary.ይርአያ: ርእየ — that he may see her (3ms jussive, r-ʾ-y, + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ይነግሮ: ነገረ — he tells him, tells it (3ms imperfect + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father')
glossary.ይእቲእግዝእትነ: ይእቲ — she, our lady (two words written as one: ይእቲ 'she' + እግዝእት 'lady' + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ደባትሪሆሙ: ደባትር — their tents (plural noun + -ሆሙ '3mp their'; meaning from context) (?)
glossary.ደንገፀ: ደንገፀ — he was startled (3ms perfect, d-n-g-ḍ)
glossary.ደወለ: ደወል — boundary, border (noun; construct/accusative 'boundary of'; uncertain)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ግብጽ: ግብጽ — Egypt (proper name; genitive after construct)
glossary.ጣዕዋ: ጣዕዋ — unknown word describing a kind of ox; meaning from context (?)
glossary.ጸግቡ: ጸገበ — they were full, satisfied (3mpl perfect, ṣ-g-b)
glossary.ጽጉበ: ጽጉብ — sated, full-fed (adjective, accusative; cf. ጸገበ 'be sated'; ጽጉበ ሐሊበ እሙ 'sated with its mother's milk')
glossary.ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ፈቀደት: ፈቀደ — she wished, wanted (3fs perfect, f-ḳ-d)
glossary.ፈቀድከ: ፈቀደ — you wished, desired (2ms perfect, G)
glossary.ፍሥሓ: ፍሥሓ — joy (construct 'joy of') · also the plain accusative 'joy' with an adjective (ኀብሩ ፍሥሓ ዐቢየ 'they joined in great joy')
glossary.፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants') · 'one' as a pronoun, 'one … another' (ይነግሮ ፩ ለካልኡ 'one tells another'; ch. 53)
glossary.፶፫: ፶፫ — 53, spoken ኀምሳ ወሠለስቱ (ḫämsa wä-śälästu) 'fifty-three'; chapter number (numeral)
